estimates.assumptions: 2 medium cucumbers ≈ 600 g total edible portion (peeled, deseeded if needed, cut into pieces); using 2.4 g carbs and 0.33 g fiber per 100 g cucumber
1/2 tsp table salt contributes no carbohydrates
2 tsp sesame oil (≈ 9 g total) is pure fat with no carbohydrates
2 tbsp rice vinegar (≈ 30 ml) has minimal residual carbs
6 fresh basil leaves ≈ 6 g total; using ≈ 2.7 g carbs and 1.6 g fiber per 100 g basil
1/2 tsp red chili flakes ≈ 1.5 g; using ≈ 69 g carbs and 45 g fiber per 100 g dried flakes
2 tsp toasted sesame seeds (≈ 6 g total); using ≈ 21.5 g carbs and 11.8 g fiber per 100 g
